title: Senior Software Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and maintain RESTful APIs using Python and Django, build CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, deploy and manage services on Kubernetes and AWS EKS, work with PostgreSQL and Redis, and collaborate with a team of 8 engineers using Agile/Scrum. Experience with Docker, Terraform, and automated testing required. Familiarity with LangChain or LLM integrations is a plus.
